citations.snippet:
• Switch: forwards a frame only to the port of the destination MAC address (data link layer).
 • Bridge: connects two LAN segments and filters traffic using MAC addresses (data link layer).
 • Router: forwards packets between different networks using IP addresses (network layer).…

answer.content: [p. 2] A LAN (Local Area Network) connects devices within a single building or campus, providing high-speed communication. Example: A network in an office building. [p. 2] A MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) covers a city, such as a cable TV network. Example: A city-wide Wi-Fi network. [p. 2] A WAN (Wide Area Network) spans a country or the world, like the Internet, connecting different networks. Example: The global internet.
